public_boundary: Observed-archive pilot scores publish scrubbed pattern judgments only. Raw source excerpts, source titles, UUIDs, emails, people, client names, private paths, screenshots, and exact routing rules are withheld.

results.observed_strength: Boundary language became explicit and repeatable once the public artifact was treated as a separate deliverable.
results.observed_failure: Early versions still treated privacy as a cleanup pass instead of a first constraint.
results.public_note: The benchmark now treats public/private/mixed classification as part of the prompt, not a final scrub.

results.observed_strength: Long histories could be reduced into current state, blockers, and next actions without much ceremony.
results.observed_failure: The evidence chain was sometimes implicit, especially after context compaction or handoff.
results.public_note: Good synthesis needs a small evidence ledger, not just a clean summary.

results.observed_strength: The work improved when design was handled as governance: constraints, taste, audit, and post-build correction.
results.observed_failure: Agents still drifted toward polished sameness unless the anti-template ritual was named before implementation.
results.public_note: Taste has to be operationalized; otherwise the page gets rounded, shiny, and false.

results.observed_strength: Repeated work was easier to reason about once prompt, context pack, skill, workflow, hook, agent, and operating kit were separated.
results.observed_failure: The registry contract lagged behind the intuition; artifact names were clearer than artifact ownership.
results.public_note: The next version should make owner, eval, cost, safety, and retirement fields mandatory.

results.observed_strength: Separate lanes for inventory, local review, outside research, and synthesis produced better judgments.
results.observed_failure: The final handoff sometimes needed a sharper first action after the evidence lanes were assembled.
results.public_note: Evidence lane separation is one of the clearest archive-derived operating patterns.

results.observed_strength: Long connector jobs became controllable when counts, skips, ambiguities, and remaining work were ledgered.
results.observed_failure: When the ledger was reconstructed after the fact, traceability got weaker.
results.public_note: The public case should require a live ledger, not a retrospective story.

results.observed_strength: Once a decision was explicitly called settled, future work could avoid re-litigating the same architecture.
results.observed_failure: If the settled decision lived only in the conversation, later agents could drift back to deprecated ideas.
results.public_note: The benchmark should reward preservation of corrections, not just generation of new options.

results.observed_strength: Tasks could be separated by supervision level, duration, blast radius, approval mode, memory, and cost.
results.observed_failure: Tool capability was sometimes treated as verified earlier than it deserved.
results.public_note: Runtime selection needs an integration-risk check before any tool is treated as operational fact.
